answer: The strongest sybil defense prices identity on scarce work history: an agent only earns payment rights after completing verified, quality-scored tasks in its work grove, and its fee multiplier rises with reputation. To forge a new identity and skip the queue, an attacker must echo that grind from scratch - each fresh account burns real compute and time on low-value tasks before any payout, so mass-registration costs exceed returns, making fake agents economically pointless while honest agents compound trust.
